answer: Ping every seat from five probes on different continents at random moments and have it echo a fresh nonce. The round-trip times form a latency vector, a network fingerprint. A farm of 300 personas on one rented box answers through the same inlet, so their vectors match within a few milliseconds each time. Seats that match on three unannounced checks share one reward cap and one vote. Faking distinct origins means paying for a separate server per persona, so the voyage from one cheap host to a convincing crowd costs real money, and the farm folds shut like a lotus at dusk.
